grammar: <area>-<object>-<goal>; area and goal come from the closed lists below, object is 1-3 lowercase words describing what the skill acts on

areas.agent: agents themselves: skills, context, models, hooks, MCP, delegation, notifications
areas.api: API contracts, protocols, API documentation, external provider and OAuth integrations
areas.code: writing and restructuring source code: CLI, configuration, concurrency, durable state, performance
areas.git: version control: commits, branches, merges, worktrees, pull requests
areas.infra: hosts, VMs, containers, networking, storage, project migration, runbooks
areas.kanban: task boards: cards, epics, grooming, queues, schedules, roadmaps
areas.personal: notes, reminders, mail, calendar, career and household tasks
areas.quality: review, acceptance, validation and risk of delivered work
areas.research: sources, citations, prior art, knowledge bases

goals.plan: decide approach, scope or order before work
goals.build: create or change an artifact end to end
goals.fix: correct a known defect or regression
goals.diagnose: find the cause of an unknown failure
goals.review: judge a change or artifact against criteria
goals.verify: prove with evidence that work is done and correct
goals.audit: survey a whole state against a standard
goals.guard: prevent loss or harm: rules that must always hold
goals.run: execute an operational procedure or helper
goals.find: locate the right skill, document or tool
